provenance.method: lesson notes written from the NERDC 2025 scheme of work outline; every week keeps its scheme topic and bullets as the teaching spine

topics.title: Free scribbling
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to hold a crayon properly
The pupils should be able to make marks on paper
Introduction:
Today we will learn to draw with crayons
We will make lines and curves like magic
Content:
Hold the crayon with your fingers
Make big strokes on big paper
Move your hand up and down
Make zigzag lines like a road
Draw circles like the sun
Class activity:
Give each child a big paper and crayons
Let them draw freely while singing
Evaluation questions:
What do we hold to draw?
Show me how to hold a crayon
What can we make with crayons?
Summary:
We learned to make marks with crayons
Drawing is fun and easy

topics.title: Colouring a ball
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify a circle
The pupils should be able to colour inside a circle
Introduction:
Today we will colour a ball
We know what a ball looks like
Content:
A ball is round like a circle
Colour inside the lines carefully
Choose your favourite colour
Press the crayon gently
Fill the whole circle with colour
Class activity:
Give each child a paper with a circle
Let them colour it with crayons
Evaluation questions:
What shape is a ball?
Show me how to hold a crayon
What colour did you use?
Summary:
We coloured a ball today
Colouring inside lines is important

topics.title: Tearing and pasting
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to tear paper into small pieces
The pupils should be able to paste paper on a shape
Introduction:
Today we will tear and paste paper
We will make a beautiful picture
Content:
Tear coloured paper into small pieces
Use your fingers to tear gently
Paste the pieces inside a big shape
Use glue stick carefully
Press down to make it stick
Class activity:
Give each child a big paper with a star shape
Let them tear coloured paper and paste inside
Evaluation questions:
What do we use to tear paper?
Show me how to paste paper
What shape did you fill?
Summary:
We learned to tear and paste paper
Making pictures with paper is fun

topics.title: Finger painting
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to paint with their fingers
The pupils should be able to make prints on paper
Introduction:
Today we will paint with our fingers
It will be messy and fun
Content:
Dip your fingers in paint
Make prints on paper like stamps
Use different colours
Wipe fingers before changing colour
Make patterns with your fingers
Class activity:
Give each child paint and paper
Let them make finger prints while singing
Evaluation questions:
What do we use to paint?
Show me how to make a print
What colours did you use?
Summary:
We painted with our fingers today
Finger painting makes beautiful patterns

topics.title: Moulding with clay
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to squeeze clay
The pupils should be able to make a ball and snake
Introduction:
Today we will play with clay
We will make shapes with our hands
Content:
Squeeze the clay with your fingers
Roll it between your palms to make a ball
Roll it like a snake on the table
Press gently to make it smooth
Make different shapes with clay
Class activity:
Give each child a piece of clay
Let them make balls and snakes
Evaluation questions:
What can we make with clay?
Show me how to roll a ball
What shape did you make?
Summary:
We played with clay today
We made balls and snakes with clay

topics.title: Printing with shapes
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to dip blocks in paint
The pupils should be able to stamp patterns on paper
Introduction:
Today we will print with blocks
We will make patterns on paper
Content:
Dip the block in paint carefully
Stamp it on paper like a stamp
Lift the block straight up
Make a pattern with the shape
Use different colours for fun
Class activity:
Give each child blocks and paint
Let them stamp patterns on paper
Evaluation questions:
What do we use to print?
Show me how to dip a block
What pattern did you make?
Summary:
We printed with blocks today
Printing makes nice patterns

topics.title: Colouring fruits
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify fruits
The pupils should be able to colour fruits correctly
Introduction:
Today we will colour fruits
We know what fruits look like
Content:
An orange is round and orange
A banana is long and yellow
Colour inside the lines carefully
Use the right colour for each fruit
Say the name of each fruit
Class activity:
Give each child pictures of fruits
Let them colour the orange and banana
Evaluation questions:
What colour is an orange?
What colour is a banana?
Show me how to colour a fruit
Summary:
We coloured fruits today
Fruits have different colours

topics.title: Sponge painting
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to dab a sponge in paint
The pupils should be able to fill a big outline
Introduction:
Today we will paint with sponges
We will fill big shapes with paint
Content:
Dab the sponge in paint gently
Press it on the paper like a stamp
Fill a big outline with sponge prints
Use different colours for fun
Make patterns with the sponge
Class activity:
Give each child a sponge and paint
Let them fill a big star shape
Evaluation questions:
What do we use to sponge paint?
Show me how to dab a sponge
What shape did you fill?
Summary:
We painted with sponges today
Sponge painting makes nice textures

topics.title: Paper ball craft
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to crush paper into balls
The pupils should be able to paste paper balls to make a bunch
Introduction:
Today we will make paper balls
We will paste them to make art
Content:
Crush paper into small balls with your hands
Use colourful paper for fun
Paste the balls on paper to make a bunch
Glue them down carefully
Make a pattern with the balls
Class activity:
Give each child paper and glue
Let them make paper balls and paste them
Evaluation questions:
What do we use to make paper balls?
Show me how to paste balls
What did you make with paper balls?
Summary:
We made paper balls today
Paper balls make nice crafts

topics.title: Art exhibition
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to display their art works
The pupils should be able to talk about their art
Introduction:
Today we will show our art
We will tell others about our work
Content:
Display all your art works on the table
Stand next to your favourite picture
Tell mummy about what you made
Say what you like about your art
Be proud of your work
Class activity:
Set up an art exhibition in class
Let each child show their work and talk about it
Evaluation questions:
What did you make in art class?
Show me your favourite picture
What do you like about your art?
Summary:
We had an art exhibition today
We are all good artists
